interfaces.label: Backplane connector
interfaces.desc: Plugs into a backplane slot. Carries CAN, the RS-485 link to the PHILEAS SB, 3.3 V and 5 V.

interfaces.label: Ethernet
interfaces.desc: Gigabit Ethernet of the Compute Module 5.

interfaces.label: USB 3.0 (Type-C)
interfaces.desc: USB 3.0 port of the Compute Module 5. Supplies 5 V through an ideal diode.

interfaces.label: Camera 0
interfaces.desc: 4-lane MIPI CSI camera interface with I²C, an enable signal and 3.3 V.

interfaces.label: Camera 1
interfaces.desc: 4-lane MIPI CSI camera interface with I²C, an enable signal and 3.3 V.

interfaces.label: M.2 slot
interfaces.desc: PCIe slot with its own switched 3.3 V supply, for an SSD.

interfaces.label: Imaging LEDs
interfaces.desc: Switched 5 V and four driven channels (white, red, green, blue) for the LEDs that light the membranes for the imaging system.

interfaces.label: Fan
interfaces.desc: Cooling fan of the Compute Module 5: 5 V, PWM and tacho.

interfaces.label: Power button
interfaces.desc: Power button of the Compute Module 5. Connected through a solder bridge.
